failed_strength_screens.page_hold_statement: The boxed headers and physical fasteners are modeled, but the bridge remains unrated and unaccepted. Full near-end/deadweight probes expose unresolved header, tongue and/or connection comparisons, including the850lbf×3 interface envelope. The300lbf single-stringer screen is limited and does not establish the full end-interface capacity.
limitations: Nominal elastic section and ideal bolt calculations only; neither a passing comparison nor zero CAD interference qualifies a joint.

A failed adverse load-distribution bound is retained explicitly; it may be resolved only by qualified load-distribution/contact analysis or a revised design and validation, not by unproven equal sharing.
Local aluminum rail/box walls, prying, sleeves, notch stress concentration, captured-head/pocket sections, handrail combinations, contact pressure/wear, fatigue and bolt locking/preload remain open.
Wheel750lbf and reference600lbf/3x are separate probes; no double factor and no combined750+600 load.
850lbf is a separate total interface allowance; its deadweight is not counted twice.
Measured operational load criteria, vehicle/station movement limits, structural proof testing and fabrication acceptance remain required.

door_screen.note: 25psf is an illustrative load case, not accepted wind design pressure. Portal reactions, slam, abuse, rail collision loads and life testing remain open.

mass_budget_note: Candidate physical component mass is not a net coach tare increment; replaced body/door allocations must be reconciled and reservations/procured parts remain excluded.
